curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with the motorist's highest duty and what right-of-way law really says, then where traffic rules come from and the work zone fines.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per principle; a card for the work zone fine amounts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the basic duties of every Missouri driver.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach passing people on foot and bikes, when passing on the right is allowed, the shoulder ban, and the places where moving left of center is forbidden.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each passing rule; contrast cards for city versus highway right-side passing and the two one-hundred-foot zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a pass and asking whether it is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover yielding to pedestrians, left turns, four-way stops, entering from driveways, uncontrolled intersections and roundabout entry.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per yielding rule; a contrast card for four-way stops, uncontrolled intersections and roundabouts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking who goes first in each intersection type.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain pulling over for moving emergency vehicles, what to do if you are in an intersection, and the move-over rule for stopped emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each response; a contrast card for moving versus stopped emergency vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on emergency vehicle scenarios.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the bus light sequence, when traffic must stop and when it need not, what to do after stopping, and the points and suspensions for failing to stop.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each school bus rule; contrast cards for stop versus no-stop roads and the suspension ladder.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a driver must stop for a school bus.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover signaling, the one-hundred-foot signal distance, lane choice for turns, common turning errors, turns between one-way and two-way streets, double left-turn lanes and U-turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each signal and turn rule; contrast cards for right-turn and left-turn errors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on choosing the starting and ending lanes of a turn.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the center two-way left-turn lane, then roundabouts from approach to exit, the truck apron, emergency vehicles at roundabouts and the J-turn.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each roundabout step; contrast cards for the two five-hundred-foot figures and the truck apron.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on roundabout and turn-lane conduct.
